verses.greek: Πρὸ δὲ τῆς ἑορτῆς τοῦ πάσχα εἰδὼς ὁ Ἰησοῦς ὅτι ἦλθεν αὐτοῦ ἡ ὥρα ἵνα μεταβῇ ἐκ τοῦ κόσμου τούτου πρὸς τὸν πατέρα ἀγαπήσας τοὺς ἰδίους τοὺς ἐν τῷ κόσμῳ εἰς τέλος ἠγάπησεν αὐτούς.
verses.literal: Before now the feast of the Passover knowing the Jesus that came to him the hour that He may depart out of the world this to the Father having loved the his own who were in the world to the end He loved them.
verses.dgt: Now before the Feast of the Passover, Jesus, knowing that his hour had come to depart from this world to the Father, having loved his own who were in the world, loved them to the end.

verses.greek: καὶ δείπνου γινομένου, τοῦ διαβόλου ἤδη βεβληκότος εἰς τὴν καρδίαν ἵνα παραδοῖ αὐτὸν Ἰούδας Σίμωνος Ἰσκαριώτου,
verses.literal: And supper taking place the devil already having put into the heart that he may betray Him Judas son of Simon Iscariot
verses.dgt: And during supper, the devil having already put into the heart of Judas son of Simon Iscariot that he should betray him,

verses.greek: εἰδὼς ὅτι πάντα ἔδωκεν αὐτῷ ὁ πατὴρ εἰς τὰς χεῖρας, καὶ ὅτι ἀπὸ θεοῦ ἐξῆλθεν καὶ πρὸς τὸν θεὸν ὑπάγει,
verses.literal: knowing that all things has given to Him the Father into the hands and that from God He came forth and to the God He is going
verses.dgt: Jesus, knowing that the Father had given all things into his hands and that he had come from God and was going to God,

verses.greek: ἐγείρεται ἐκ τοῦ δείπνου καὶ τίθησιν τὰ ἱμάτια καὶ λαβὼν λέντιον διέζωσεν ἑαυτόν·
verses.literal: He rises from the supper and lays aside the garments And having taken a towel He girded Himself.
verses.dgt: gets up from supper, lays aside his outer garments, and taking a towel, tied it around himself.

verses.greek: εἶτα βάλλει ὕδωρ εἰς τὸν νιπτῆρα, καὶ ἤρξατο νίπτειν τοὺς πόδας τῶν μαθητῶν καὶ ἐκμάσσειν τῷ λεντίῳ ᾧ ἦν διεζωσμένος.
verses.literal: After that He pours water into the basin and He began to wash the feet of the disciples and to wipe them with the towel with which He was having girded himself.
verses.dgt: Then he pours water into the washbasin and began to wash the disciples’ feet and to wipe them with the towel that was tied around him.

verses.greek: ἔρχεται οὖν πρὸς Σίμωνα Πέτρον. λέγει αὐτῷ· Κύριε, σύ μου νίπτεις τοὺς πόδας;
verses.literal: He comes then to Simon Peter who says to Him Lord You yourself my do wash the feet?
verses.dgt: So he comes to Simon Peter. He says to him, “Lord, are you washing my feet?”

verses.greek: ἀπεκρίθη Ἰησοῦς καὶ εἶπεν αὐτῷ· Ὃ ἐγὼ ποιῶ σὺ οὐκ οἶδας ἄρτι, γνώσῃ δὲ μετὰ ταῦτα.
verses.literal: Answered Jesus and said to him What I myself do you yourself not know presently you will know however after these things.
verses.dgt: Jesus answered and said to him, “What I am doing you do not understand now, but you will know after these things.”

verses.greek: λέγει αὐτῷ Πέτρος· Οὐ μὴ νίψῃς μου τοὺς πόδας εἰς τὸν αἰῶνα. ἀπεκρίθη Ἰησοῦς αὐτῷ· Ἐὰν μὴ νίψω σε, οὐκ ἔχεις μέρος μετʼ ἐμοῦ.
verses.literal: Says to Him Peter certainly not shall You wash my the feet to the age. Answered Jesus to him only unless I shall wash you not you have part with Me.
verses.dgt: Peter says to him, “You will never wash my feet!” Jesus answered him, “Unless I wash you, you have no share with me.”

verses.greek: λέγει αὐτῷ Σίμων Πέτρος· Κύριε, μὴ τοὺς πόδας μου μόνον ἀλλὰ καὶ τὰς χεῖρας καὶ τὴν κεφαλήν.
verses.literal: Says to Him Simon Peter Lord not the feet of me only but also the hands and the head.
verses.dgt: Simon Peter says to him, “Lord, not my feet only, but also my hands and my head!”

verses.greek: λέγει αὐτῷ ὁ Ἰησοῦς· Ὁ λελουμένος οὐκ ἔχει χρείαν εἰ μὴ τοὺς πόδας νίψασθαι, ἀλλʼ ἔστιν καθαρὸς ὅλος· καὶ ὑμεῖς καθαροί ἐστε, ἀλλʼ οὐχὶ πάντες.
verses.literal: Says to him the Jesus The one having bathed himself not has need only except the feet to wash but is clean wholly and you yourselves clean are but not all.
verses.dgt: Jesus says to him, “The one who has bathed has no need except to wash his feet, but is wholly clean. And you are clean, but not all of you.”

verses.greek: ᾔδει γὰρ τὸν παραδιδόντα αὐτόν· διὰ τοῦτο εἶπεν ὅτι Οὐχὶ πάντες καθαροί ἐστε.
verses.literal: He knew for the one who was betraying Him on account of this He said that Not all clean you are.
verses.dgt: For he knew the one betraying him; for this reason he said, “Not all of you are clean.”

verses.greek: Ὅτε οὖν ἔνιψεν τοὺς πόδας αὐτῶν καὶ ἔλαβεν τὰ ἱμάτια αὐτοῦ καὶ ἀνέπεσεν, πάλιν εἶπεν αὐτοῖς· Γινώσκετε τί πεποίηκα ὑμῖν;
verses.literal: When therefore He had washed the feet of them and taken the garments of Him and he reclined again He said to them Do you know what I have done to you?
verses.dgt: So when he had washed their feet, taken his garments, and reclined again, he said to them, “Do you understand what I have done to you?

verses.greek: ὑμεῖς φωνεῖτέ με Ὁ διδάσκαλος καὶ Ὁ κύριος, καὶ καλῶς λέγετε, εἰμὶ γάρ.
verses.literal: You yourselves call Me: the Teacher and the Lord and rightly you say I am for.
verses.dgt: You call me ‘Teacher’ and ‘Lord,’ and you speak rightly, for I am.

verses.greek: εἰ οὖν ἐγὼ ἔνιψα ὑμῶν τοὺς πόδας ὁ κύριος καὶ ὁ διδάσκαλος, καὶ ὑμεῖς ὀφείλετε ἀλλήλων νίπτειν τοὺς πόδας·
verses.literal: If therefore I myself washed your the feet the Lord and the Teacher also you yourselves ought of one another to wash the feet
verses.dgt: So if I, the Lord and the Teacher, washed your feet, you also ought to wash one another’s feet.

verses.greek: ὑπόδειγμα γὰρ ἔδωκα ὑμῖν ἵνα καθὼς ἐγὼ ἐποίησα ὑμῖν καὶ ὑμεῖς ποιῆτε.
verses.literal: A pattern for I gave you that even as I myself did to you also you yourselves may do.
verses.dgt: For I gave you an example, so that just as I did to you, you also should do.

verses.greek: ἀμὴν ἀμὴν λέγω ὑμῖν, οὐκ ἔστιν δοῦλος μείζων τοῦ κυρίου αὐτοῦ οὐδὲ ἀπόστολος μείζων τοῦ πέμψαντος αὐτόν.
verses.literal: Amen Amen I say to you not is a servant greater than the master of him nor is a messenger greater than the one who having sent him.
verses.dgt: Truly, truly, I say to you: a slave is not greater than his master, nor is a messenger greater than the one who sent him.

verses.greek: εἰ ταῦτα οἴδατε, μακάριοί ἐστε ἐὰν ποιῆτε αὐτά.
verses.literal: If these things you know blessed are you if you shall do them.
verses.dgt: If you know these things, blessed are you if you do them.

verses.greek: οὐ περὶ πάντων ὑμῶν λέγω· ἐγὼ οἶδα τίνας ἐξελεξάμην· ἀλλʼ ἵνα ἡ γραφὴ πληρωθῇ· Ὁ τρώγων μου τὸν ἄρτον ἐπῆρεν ἐπʼ ἐμὲ τὴν πτέρναν αὐτοῦ.
verses.literal: Not about all of you I speak I myself know whom I chose but that the Scripture may be fulfilled: The one eating Me the bread lifted up against Me myself the heel of him.’
verses.dgt: I am not speaking about all of you. I know whom I chose. But it is so that the Scripture may be fulfilled: ‘The one eating my bread lifted his heel against me.’

verses.greek: ἀπʼ ἄρτι λέγω ὑμῖν πρὸ τοῦ γενέσθαι, ἵνα πιστεύσητε ὅταν γένηται ὅτι ἐγώ εἰμι.
verses.literal: From now I am telling you before the it comes to pass so that you may believe when it may happen that I myself am He.
verses.dgt: From now on I am telling you before it happens, so that when it happens you may believe that I am.

verses.greek: ἀμὴν ἀμὴν λέγω ὑμῖν, ὁ λαμβάνων ἄν τινα πέμψω ἐμὲ λαμβάνει, ὁ δὲ ἐμὲ λαμβάνων λαμβάνει τὸν πέμψαντά με.
verses.literal: Amen Amen I say to you the one receiving maybe any I shall send Me myself receives the one now Me myself receiving receives the One having sent Me.
verses.dgt: Truly, truly, I say to you: the one who receives anyone I send receives me, and the one who receives me receives the one who sent me.”

verses.greek: Ταῦτα εἰπὼν ὁ Ἰησοῦς ἐταράχθη τῷ πνεύματι καὶ ἐμαρτύρησεν καὶ εἶπεν· Ἀμὴν ἀμὴν λέγω ὑμῖν ὅτι εἷς ἐξ ὑμῶν παραδώσει με.
verses.literal: These things having said the Jesus was troubled the in spirit and He testified and said Amen Amen I say to you that one of you will betray Me.
verses.dgt: After saying these things, Jesus was troubled in spirit and testified and said, “Truly, truly, I say to you that one of you will betray me.”

verses.greek: ἔβλεπον εἰς ἀλλήλους οἱ μαθηταὶ ἀπορούμενοι περὶ τίνος λέγει.
verses.literal: Were looking upon one another the disciples being uncertain of whom He is speaking.
verses.dgt: The disciples were looking at one another, uncertain about whom he was speaking.

verses.greek: ἦν ἀνακείμενος εἷς ἐκ τῶν μαθητῶν αὐτοῦ ἐν τῷ κόλπῳ τοῦ Ἰησοῦ, ὃν ἠγάπα ὁ Ἰησοῦς·
verses.literal: There was reclining one of the disciples of Him in the bosom the of Jesus whom was loving the Jesus
verses.dgt: One of his disciples, whom Jesus loved, was reclining at Jesus’ side.

verses.greek: νεύει οὖν τούτῳ Σίμων Πέτρος πυθέσθαι τίς ἂν εἴη περὶ οὗ λέγει.
verses.literal: Motions therefore to him Simon Peter to ask who maybe it would be about whom He is speaking.
verses.dgt: So Simon Peter motions to him to ask who it might be about whom he is speaking.

verses.greek: ἀναπεσὼν ἐκεῖνος οὕτως ἐπὶ τὸ στῆθος τοῦ Ἰησοῦ λέγει αὐτῷ· Κύριε, τίς ἐστιν;
verses.literal: Having leaned he thus on the breast the of Jesus he says to Him Lord who is it?
verses.dgt: Leaning back in this way against Jesus’ chest, he says to him, “Lord, who is it?”

verses.greek: ἀποκρίνεται ὁ Ἰησοῦς· Ἐκεῖνός ἐστιν ᾧ ἐγὼ βάψω τὸ ψωμίον καὶ δώσω αὐτῷ· βάψας οὖν τὸ ψωμίον δίδωσιν Ἰούδᾳ Σίμωνος Ἰσκαριώτου.
verses.literal: Answers the Jesus He it is to whom I myself will dip the morsel and will give to him. having dipped then the morsel gives it to Judas son of Simon Iscariot.
verses.dgt: Jesus answers, “It is the one for whom I will dip the piece of bread and give it to him.” So after dipping the piece of bread, he gives it to Judas son of Simon Iscariot.

verses.greek: καὶ μετὰ τὸ ψωμίον τότε εἰσῆλθεν εἰς ἐκεῖνον ὁ Σατανᾶς. λέγει οὖν αὐτῷ ὁ Ἰησοῦς· Ὃ ποιεῖς ποίησον τάχιον.
verses.literal: And after the morsel then entered into him the Satan. Says therefore to him the Jesus What you enact do enact quicker.
verses.dgt: And after the piece of bread, then Satan entered into him. So Jesus says to him, “What you are doing, do quickly.”

verses.greek: τοῦτο δὲ οὐδεὶς ἔγνω τῶν ἀνακειμένων πρὸς τί εἶπεν αὐτῷ·
verses.literal: This now no one knew of those reclining to what He spoke to him.
verses.dgt: But none of those reclining understood why he said this to him.

verses.greek: τινὲς γὰρ ἐδόκουν, ἐπεὶ τὸ γλωσσόκομον εἶχεν Ἰούδας, ὅτι λέγει αὐτῷ ὁ Ἰησοῦς· Ἀγόρασον ὧν χρείαν ἔχομεν εἰς τὴν ἑορτήν, ἢ τοῖς πτωχοῖς ἵνα τι δῷ.
verses.literal: Some for were thinking since the money bag had Judas for is saying to him the Jesus do buy what things need of we have for the feast or to the poor that something he may give.
verses.dgt: For some were thinking, since Judas had the money box, that Jesus was telling him, “Buy what we need for the feast,” or that he should give something to the poor.

verses.greek: λαβὼν οὖν τὸ ψωμίον ἐκεῖνος ἐξῆλθεν εὐθύς. ἦν δὲ νύξ.
verses.literal: Having received therefore the morsel he went out immediately it was now night.
verses.dgt: So after receiving the piece of bread, he went out immediately. And it was night.

verses.greek: Ὅτε οὖν ἐξῆλθεν λέγει Ἰησοῦς· Νῦν ἐδοξάσθη ὁ υἱὸς τοῦ ἀνθρώπου, καὶ ὁ θεὸς ἐδοξάσθη ἐν αὐτῷ·
verses.literal: When therefore he had gone out says Jesus Now has been glorified the Son the of Man and the God has been glorified in Him
verses.dgt: When he had gone out, Jesus says, “Now the Son of Man has been glorified, and God has been glorified in him.

verses.greek: εἰ ὁ θεὸς ἐδοξάσθη ἐν αὐτῷ, καὶ ὁ θεὸς δοξάσει αὐτὸν ἐν αὑτῷ, καὶ εὐθὺς δοξάσει αὐτόν.
verses.literal: If the God is glorified in Him also the God will glorify Him in Himself and immediately will glorify Him.
verses.dgt: If God has been glorified in him, God will also glorify him in himself, and will glorify him immediately.

verses.greek: τεκνία, ἔτι μικρὸν μεθʼ ὑμῶν εἰμι· ζητήσετέ με, καὶ καθὼς εἶπον τοῖς Ἰουδαίοις ὅτι Ὅπου ἐγὼ ὑπάγω ὑμεῖς οὐ δύνασθε ἐλθεῖν, καὶ ὑμῖν λέγω ἄρτι.
verses.literal: Little children yet a little while with you I am. You will seek Me and even as I said to the Jews that Where I myself go you yourselves not are able to come also to you I say now.
verses.dgt: Little children, I am with you only a little longer. You will seek me, and just as I said to the Jews, ‘Where I am going you cannot come,’ I now say also to you.

verses.greek: ἐντολὴν καινὴν δίδωμι ὑμῖν ἵνα ἀγαπᾶτε ἀλλήλους, καθὼς ἠγάπησα ὑμᾶς ἵνα καὶ ὑμεῖς ἀγαπᾶτε ἀλλήλους.
verses.literal: A commandment new I give to you that you may love one another even as I have loved you so also you yourselves may love one another.
verses.dgt: I give you a new command: that you love one another. Just as I loved you, you also are to love one another.

verses.greek: ἐν τούτῳ γνώσονται πάντες ὅτι ἐμοὶ μαθηταί ἐστε, ἐὰν ἀγάπην ἔχητε ἐν ἀλλήλοις.
verses.literal: By this will know all that to Me disciples you are if love you shall have among one another.
verses.dgt: By this everyone will know that you are my disciples, if you have love for one another.”

verses.greek: Λέγει αὐτῷ Σίμων Πέτρος· Κύριε, ποῦ ὑπάγεις; ἀπεκρίθη Ἰησοῦς· Ὅπου ὑπάγω οὐ δύνασαί μοι νῦν ἀκολουθῆσαι, ἀκολουθήσεις δὲ ὕστερον.
verses.literal: Says to Him Simon Peter Lord where go You? Answered Jesus Where I go not you are able Me now to follow you will follow however afterward
verses.dgt: Simon Peter says to him, “Lord, where are you going?” Jesus answered, “Where I am going you cannot follow me now, but you will follow later.”

verses.greek: λέγει αὐτῷ ὁ Πέτρος· Κύριε, διὰ τί οὐ δύναμαί σοι ἀκολουθῆσαι ἄρτι; τὴν ψυχήν μου ὑπὲρ σοῦ θήσω.
verses.literal: Says to Him the Peter Lord because of why not am I able You to follow presently? The life of mine for You I will lay down.
verses.dgt: Peter says to him, “Lord, why can I not follow you now? I will lay down my life for you.”

verses.greek: ἀποκρίνεται Ἰησοῦς· Τὴν ψυχήν σου ὑπὲρ ἐμοῦ θήσεις; ἀμὴν ἀμὴν λέγω σοι, οὐ μὴ ἀλέκτωρ φωνήσῃ ἕως οὗ ἀρνήσῃ με τρίς.
verses.literal: answers Jesus The life of you for Me will you lay down? Amen Amen I say to you certainly not the rooster may crow until that you will deny Me three times.
verses.dgt: Jesus answers, “Will you lay down your life for me? Truly, truly, I say to you: a rooster will certainly not crow until you deny me three times.”
